about_the_game:
Challenge authority, rewrite reality itself, and reshape the world of Aeonrealm with your law bending abilities! With your partner who calls itself an Echo, your goal is to save Aeonrealm from itself.

Isle of Echoes is Looter-Slasher where you use the abilities of your echoes to bring peace (or chaos) to the land of Aeonrealm! When your Bonded wakes up in Aeonrealm, she can't remember what brought her there or her goal. Through her journey to find out, she sees the struggles of the Aeonites, hopefully she'll make the right choices.

Echoes are ancient spirits that were trapped in devices called Projectors. When a bonded has freed an echo from its projector and well...bonded with it. The echo will be grateful and offer assistance with their adventures. Each having a unique personality, design, backstory, and abilities. Which can range from controlling the direction of gravity to...gambling

The Regions

  • Cujakawa (Earth)

  • Æresbjerg (Copenhagen, Denmark) Year: 1431

  • Shìchǎng Chéng (Fujian, China) Year: 1807

  • Dublin (Ireland) Year: 1834

  • Gearheart (New York City, USA) Year: 1890

  • Badamjeon (Gwangju, South Korea) Year: 2003

  • Amowari (77°52'27"S 34°37'38"W, Antarctica) Year: 2033

  • D.C. (Washington, DC, USA) Year: 2036

  • Wastelands (State of Amapá, Brazil) Year: 2041

  • Badlands (Sahara Desert) Year: 2044

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated compatible with DirectX
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible HMD (Valve Index, Quest 2 w/ Link, Vive Pro, etc.)
  • Additional Notes: Stable VR performance at lower quality settings, no reprojection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated compatible with DirectX
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible HMD (Valve Index, Quest 2 w/ Link, Vive Pro, etc.)
  • Additional Notes: Required for full visual fidelity and smooth VR experience with cel-shading post-processing

short_description: Isle of Echoes is a VR Looter-Slasher with your spirit partner called an Echo. Upgrade their abilities as you go from region to region giving the power back to the people. As you get closer and closer to your goal, Aeon Park will be continuing his plan to take over the new world.
